main.summary: Represents a readable staged stream transfer segment together with its response footer metadata.

property.name: Footer
property.summary: Response footer metadata describing the returned stream segment.

property.name: Payload
property.summary: Readable payload stream for the returned segment.

method.name: FinalizeFooter
method.summary: Finalize the response footer by extracting the segment hash from the hashing payload stream.
method.returns: Finalized response footer including the returned segment hash.
